title: The Harmonic Variational Principle for the Einstein-Hilbert Functional
summary: Let (M,g) be a compact n-dimensional Riemannian manifold, n>2. We introduce a restricted variational principle for the Einstein-Hilbert functional by requiring the admissible metric variations to satisfy the harmonic gauge condition. We derive the corresponding Euler-Lagrange equation and show that a metric is critical with respect to all volume-preserving harmonic variations if and only if its Einstein tensor differs from a multiple of the metric by an element of the image of the adjoint Bianchi operator.
